description: Fork a saved build into a new autosaved draft. Use this instead of editing the existing build when the user wants a variant and the original must stay intact. The fork copies the uploader configuration and media references, receives a new build ID, and can be edited independently. Confirm that the fork was created; share its URL only when the user asks for it or says there is no open uploader tab. Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. With campaign.id alone, new ad sets are created. copyFromAd behavior is unchanged.

buildId.description: Saved build ID to duplicate, e.g. build_abc123...
